question: Can Saint-Donat/Nikulin K3 linear-system theory close HPADJ-07 gates B-C for the charged terminal population?

saint_donat.citation: Bernard Saint-Donat, Projective models of K-3 surfaces, American Journal of Mathematics 96 (1974), 602-639
load_bearing_statements: If a nonempty complete linear system on a K3 surface has no fixed components and L^2>0, its general member is irreducible (Saint-Donat Proposition 2.6).
For fixed-component-free systems, Saint-Donat gives base-point-freeness and the projective-model classification used downstream.

nikulin_urabe.citation: Tohsuke Urabe, On Nikulin's theorem on fixed components of linear systems on K3 surfaces, Journal of the Mathematical Society of Japan 45 (1993), 185-195
nikulin_urabe.load_bearing_statement: For a nef line bundle L on a K3 surface with L^2>0, if |L| has a fixed component then the system is of the special elliptic-pencil plus (-2)-curve form m|E|+Gamma with E^2=0, E.Gamma=1, Gamma^2=-2; otherwise a general member is irreducible.

chen_gounelas_liedtke.citation: Xi Chen, Frank Gounelas, Christian Liedtke, Rational curves on lattice-polarised K3 surfaces, Algebraic Geometry 9 (2022), 443-475
chen_gounelas_liedtke.reason: Their integral nodal rational-curve existence theorem is for generic lattice-polarised K3 surfaces under positivity hypotheses; Stage32 source-locks one specific non-K3 cuboid surface.

bogomolov_mumford.reason: Existence of a divisor that is a sum of rational curves in an effective K3 class does not by itself produce an integral irreducible carrier, and again requires a K3 surface.

repo_surface_source_lock.surface: minimal desingularization of the cuboid surface
repo_surface_source_lock.conclusion: The Stage32 carrier surface S is not a K3 surface; K3 has trivial canonical class, hence K^2=0 and chi(O)=2 over characteristic zero.

reason: Stage32 carrier classes live on the minimal desingularization S of the cuboid surface, whose source-locked invariants are K_S^2=16, p_g=7, q=0.

HPADJ-rejected matching carrier classes are forced by the already-audited HPADJ inequality to satisfy C^2<-2 if such a carrier existed; this is not the positive-square nef line-bundle regime of the K3 theorems.

auxiliary_k3_quotient_route.known_fact: The published degree-6 proof uses a long-diagonal-sign K3 quotient and then checks lifts back to S.
auxiliary_k3_quotient_route.non_generalization_lock: The retained Stage29 source explicitly states that the degree-6 K3 reduction does not automatically generalize to all degrees.
auxiliary_k3_quotient_route.required_new_statement: A population-preserving theorem assigning every relevant Stage32 carrier (or every HPADJ charged authority class under the intended semantics) to a specific K3 quotient line bundle L, with exact pullback/lift compatibility of degree, Picard class, integrality, irreducibility and normalization/branch data.
auxiliary_k3_quotient_route.then_possible_use: Only after that bridge could Saint-Donat/Nikulin reduce the K3-side fixed-component-free case to irreducible general members and isolate the mE+Gamma exceptional case.

chain_effect.gate_A: retained separately as provisional exact integral-completion research evidence
chain_effect.gate_B: OPEN; K3 literature does not supply effectivity on S
chain_effect.gate_C: OPEN; K3 literature does not supply an integral irreducible representative on S
chain_effect.best_next_route: Search for a theorem intrinsic to the cuboid surface/general-type surface S, or prove an explicit population-wide S-to-K3 quotient/lift bridge; do not apply Saint-Donat/Nikulin directly to S.
